description.zh: 术士在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Warlock talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【痛苦 Beta 开荒】5 点让腐蚀术瞬发，再补命中与法力续航，连续拉怪也不用坐下喝水。 【恶魔学识 Beta 开荒】所有点数都投给恶魔：宠物伤害提高 10%、生命与法力提高 15%，你的法术伤害还会治疗它。
body.en: [Affliction Beta Start] Instant Corruption at five points, then hit and Mana sustain so you can chain pulls without drinking. [Demonology Beta Start] Every point goes into the demon: 10% more pet damage, 15% more pet health and Mana, and your spell damage healing it.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.
